doc.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001

title: Bill Harris the practical joker
summary: Roommate Bill Harris and the Third Man Theme.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Yeah. You’ve worked also with a couple of good practical jokers: Bill Harris.
Did he ever pull anything on ya?

Well I went back with Woody in ’50. And he was on the band. This was after we had that three trombone thing in ’49. And I roomed with him. So one night I get up and he’s walking around with the headphones and he’s doing — on everything. So I said, “hey Bill, it’s like three o’clock in the morning, what are you doing?” He said, “put the headphones on.” So I put the headphones on. He goes [scats] that’s what he was doing. But he’d do all kinds of things.
Really. What tune was it — sing that tune again.
It was something. He was a lot of fun.
Him and Chubby. A lot of energy.
